items.title: Repository scope mismatch (NBA archive vs NFL request)
items.detail: The checked-in repository is an NBA line-origination workspace (README, data/, docs/, engine/, lab/, own4-dashboard/). The user request is NFL. All prior NBA outputs are retained as archive and are NOT used as NFL evidence. This NFL deliverable lives entirely in nfl/** plus NFL_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md.
items.impact: Do not read NBA standings, NBA leaderboards or NBA 'verified' claims as NFL findings.

items.title: No official NFL betting lines or closing lines
items.detail: https://www.nfl.com/odds/ returned the official 404 'Flag on the Play' page on 2026-11-02. No official NFL source publishes market spreads, totals, moneylines or closing lines. All market-price and CLV cells are BLANK. Gate G10 therefore fails for every strategy and closing-line value cannot be computed.
items.impact: CLV test and market comparison are impossible; do not substitute third-party odds.

items.title: Committed unresolved Git conflict markers in shared files
items.detail: COORDINATION.md and README.md contain literal <<<<<<< HEAD / ======= / >>>>>>> origin/main markers committed by earlier sessions. They are preserved, not deleted, and repaired in final integration by keeping both sides.
items.impact: Shared-file editing must not discard either side's text.

items.title: All model parameters are project-defined, not official
items.detail: K=20, Elo divisor 400, 25 points per rating unit, +2.5 home advantage, 13.5-point margin sigma, Pythagorean exponent 2.37, total shrink 0.5 and the 2025 prior are engineering choices. No official NFL source publishes or endorses them. They are frozen in nfl/data/preregistration.json.
items.impact: Fair lines are ORIGINATED, not verified market prices.

items.title: Correlation thresholds and leg definitions are project-defined
items.detail: The ≥24 home points and ≥45 total points leg definitions, the 0.20 dependence block threshold and the 0.05 alpha are project policy, not official NFL values. Some correlation pairs have n below 20 or use non-independent pairs.
items.impact: Correlation values are computed from official data but the cut-offs are policy.

items.title: Validation-gate thresholds are project policy
items.detail: n ≥ 300 graded independent observations is a project-set minimum sample. It is not an official NFL or regulatory requirement.
items.impact: Every strategy fails G2 in this 8-week sample.

items.title: -110 break-even and payout economics have no official NFL source
items.detail: The 0.5238 break-even hit rate is a sportsbook-pricing convention; no official NFL page publishes it. Operator settlement rules use official governing-body statistics, but the price/juice is not confirmed from an official source in this project.
items.impact: Gate G5 and parlay break-even values are policy; leave 'official price' blank.

items.title: DraftKings correlated-parlay clause only partially retrievable
items.detail: The official operator House Rules page (Version 18 – 09.03.2026) and the official v15 PDF were fetched, but the regulator-hosted copy that carries the full parlay definition ('two or more legs ... requires every leg to be settled as won') and the correlated-selection prohibition failed to download in full. The clause exists in the official-page search index but the complete rule text was not read line by line.
items.impact: Do not state a specific void/correlation rule as fully verified; the project simply refuses to price correlated legs independently.

items.title: Rewards are non-monetary and unfunded
items.detail: The leaderboard competition awards Gold/Silver/Bronze status points (100/60/30). There is no funded prize pool, sponsor, or official NFL reward programme. No external reward claim is made.
items.impact: Reward tiers are project mechanics only.

items.title: Scoring point values left blank
items.detail: The official 2026 Rulebook page confirms Rule 11 sections (Value of Scores, Touchdown, Try, Field Goal, Safety) but the numeric point values (6/3/2/1/2) were not retrievable in the fetched official page text. The value cells are BLANK rather than filled from memory.
items.impact: Never infer rulebook numbers.

items.title: Small sample; no validated skill-based strategy
items.detail: 120 official finals across 8 weeks, 88 walk-forward predictions, 60 QB rows. No strategy passes all 12 gates; 0 rewards awarded. The 0.586 winner accuracy is not significant after multiple-testing control.
items.impact: Publish no 'winning strategy' claim.

items.title: Home/away designation for international and neutral-site games
items.detail: NFL.com lists home/away designations for international games (e.g. Week 9 Bengals at Falcons in Madrid). Home-field advantage is set to zero for the games explicitly marked neutral in the official schedule data; other designations are taken verbatim from NFL.com and not reinterpreted.
items.impact: A small number of fair spreads may differ from a true-venue model.

items.title: Live in-season snapshot; Week 8 Monday game not final
items.detail: At retrieval (2026-11-02 UTC) Bears at Seahawks (W8 MNF) had not concluded and is excluded from all 120 finals. 2026 standings are a live snapshot and will change after that game and Week 9.
items.impact: Any recomputation after Week 8 MNF will legitimately differ.

items.title: Duplicate legacy dashboards with conflicting leaderboard claims
items.detail: Root index.html, docs/, lab/, lines-lab/, own4-dashboard/ and pipeline/ each contain prior-session NBA dashboards and leaderboard/summary claims. They are retained as archive; this NFL site is a separate namespace and does not endorse or reconcile those numbers.
items.impact: Read only nfl/** for NFL findings.

items.title: NBA-named CI workflow and NBA fetch workflow
items.detail: .github/workflows/pages.yml is named 'Validate NBA research workspace' and .github/workflows/fetch-nba-data.yml fetches NBA data. Final integration adds NFL checks while keeping the legacy NBA checks passing; the NBA fetch workflow is left untouched.
items.impact: Workflow name is stale but the checks remain valid.

items.title: Player-prop medians come from 8 quarterbacks only
items.detail: The 60 game-log rows cover 8 official NFL.com QB stat pages, not the full league. Dev-set medians are computed from 16 Week 1-2 rows and are not league-wide distributions.
items.impact: Prop-combo results are illustrative, not a validated player-prop market.

items.title: Cross-game parlay combinations share legs
items.detail: Week-level parlay combinations reuse the same games, so the combinations are not independent observations. Wilson intervals and binomial p-values for S09/S10 are therefore naïve and must not be treated as confirmatory.
items.impact: G2 is not satisfied by counting parlay combinations.

items.title: Parallel-session branch/worktree convention not available
items.detail: The user requested one branch/worktree named session-<id>/<task> per task. This platform pins the session to a single branch arena/01575b2d-own4 and forbids creating or pushing other branches. Non-overlap is instead enforced by the nfl/** file namespace; the deviation is logged in COORDINATION.md.
items.impact: Only one branch is pushed; no parallel branch merge was performed.

items.title: No official injury/availability data ingested for Week 9
items.detail: Only the official reporting DEADLINES are verified (Practice Report by 4:00 p.m. NY Wed/Thu/Fri for Sunday games; Game Status Report Friday). No team injury report was transcribed, so availability signals are absent from the Week 9 lines.
items.impact: Week 9 fair lines do not adjust for injuries.

items.title: Tie game handling
items.detail: Week 5 Giants 27, Commanders 27 is a tie. Winner accuracy excludes it; Brier/log loss treat it as y=0.5. This is project policy, consistent with the official standings which record a T column.
items.impact: One observation is removed from winner grading.

items.title: Pre-registration clarification recorded before strategy analysis
items.detail: The ambiguous word 'median' in S12/S13/S14 is defined in clarification_log as a fixed Weeks 1-2 development-set median, with a minimum of 2 strictly-prior QB games. No frozen numeric parameter was changed; the clarification was written before analysis.py executed.
items.impact: Prop-combo thresholds are reproducible and free of look-ahead.
